    - heading "2 NOTICE THE PATTERN" [level=2]
    - text: Each full icon shows 1 unit.
    - paragraph: A half icon shows half of the key value.
    - strong: 🍎 ＋ 🍎 = 2 fruits
  - text: →

    - heading "3 UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Total = (Full icons × Key) + (Half icons × Key ÷ 2)
  - text: →

    - text: Do not count every half icon as 1 full icon.

  - complementary:
    - heading "Key Rule / Definition" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A pictograph uses pictures or symbols to represent data.
    - list:
      - listitem: Key tells how many units each picture represents.
      - listitem: Full icon = value of the key.
      - listitem: Half icon = half of the key value.
    - heading "Why it works" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Pictures make data easy to see and compare quickly.
    - strong: 🍎 ＋ 🍎 = 2 units
